priorDeployedGroup.title: Warehouse stock count
priorDeployedGroup.passage:
Quarterly stock count — Warehouse B

The count will take place on Friday from 1 to 5 p.m. During this period, routine material issues and receipts will pause. Production teams should collect materials for the afternoon by noon.

Urgent requests may be authorized by the warehouse manager. If a transaction is approved during the count, record it on the temporary movement sheet and give a copy to the counting team. Do not rely on a verbal message alone.

Counting pairs will compare physical quantities with the stock list. Differences should be recorded and checked a second time before any inventory adjustment is made. Damaged stock must be counted separately rather than omitted.
priorDeployedGroup.passageZh:
季度盤點——B 倉庫

盤點將於星期五下午一點至五點進行，期間暫停一般物料領用與收貨。生產團隊應在中午前領取下午需要的材料。

緊急需求可由倉庫經理核准。若盤點期間核准一筆出入庫，須記錄於臨時異動表，並交一份副本給盤點團隊，不能只靠口頭傳達。

兩人一組的盤點人員將比對實際數量與庫存清單。差異應先記錄並二次查核，再調整庫存紀錄。受損庫存必須另行計數，不能漏列。

legacyQuestions.prompt: What should production teams do before noon?
legacyQuestions.promptZh: 生產團隊應在中午前做什麼？

options.whyZh: 調整要在盤點、複核差異之後，非中午前。
受損材料應另計，不是丟棄。

options.zh: 永久關閉 B 倉庫
options.whyZh: 只是下午的季度盤點，沒有永久關倉。

options.text: Collect materials needed for the afternoon
options.whyZh: 一般出入庫午後暫停，所以通知要求提前領料。

legacyQuestions.explanationZh: 一般出入庫午後暫停，所以通知要求提前領料。
legacyQuestions.evidence: Production teams should collect materials for the afternoon by noon.

vocabulary.note: 查明差異後修正系統中的庫存紀錄。
將庫存材料發給使用部門。

legacyQuestions.prompt: How should damaged stock be treated?

options.text: Send it to production without inspection
options.whyZh: 通知沒有此安排，且受損品不能被當一般領料處理。
公告最後一句明確指定另行計數。

options.text: Automatically adjust its quantity to zero
options.whyZh: 任何調整前都要先查核差異，未授權直接歸零。

legacyQuestions.explanationZh: 公告最後一句明確指定另行計數。
legacyQuestions.evidence: Damaged stock must be counted separately rather than omitted.
